frame.note: drawing frame: origin at the part's bounding-box corner; Z = sheet normal (flat) or the smallest extent; X the longer of the other two. Datum C = the x = 0 edge, B = the y = 0 edge, A = the z = 0 face.

bend_edge.quote: Bend-to-edge tolerance: +/- 0.015″ (each additional bend adds at least 0.015″)

flat.source: mechloop class value (tolerance/process.py sheet flat, 2 standard deviations); SendCutSend publishes none for this

predictions.finding: nut_plate: 4 hole(s) or cut-out(s) narrower than the 9.525 mm sheet (smallest 4.80 mm at [-19.0, 201.6, 140.42]): they cut, but taper and lose accuracy.
nut_plate: 4 hole(s) with less than 9.525 mm of material to the edge (least 4.80 mm at [19.0, 217.9, 140.42]): the web overheats and distorts, and tears if the part is bent or loaded.
nut_plate: 1 slot(s) or notch(es) in the outline narrower than 9.525 mm (narrowest about 6.20 mm at [-7.31, 208.91, 140.42]): the cut is ragged and the slot closes up with heat.

nut_plate: SendCutSend rule sendcutsend.cut.hole_min_al6061_page: smallest hole or cut-out 4.8 mm (4 of 4), limit >= 9.53 mm (warning: the supplier's words: "Design holes no smaller than material thickness.").

nut_plate: SendCutSend rule sendcutsend.cut.hole_edge_al6061_page: hole edge to part edge 4.8 mm (4 of 4), limit >= 14.3 mm (warning: the supplier's words: "Keep holes and cutouts 1.5–2× material thickness away from edges to prevent warping or distortion.").

nut_plate: SendCutSend rule sendcutsend.cut.hole_edge_d_ratio: hole edge to part edge 5 mm (2 of 4), limit >= 5.5 mm (warning: the supplier's words: "we generally recommend keeping your holes at least 1X their diameter from an edge and slots at least 1.5X their width away from edges or other cut features.").

nut_plate: 6 outside corner(s) of the cut profile are dead sharp (no radius). A sheet part with needle corners cuts hands and cables and chips its paint; a corner radius costs nothing in laser or waterjet cutting.
